endpoints.note: 1st call (entry 6) was made by the SPA app.initialize() before login with X-CSRFTOKEN: "null" and returned HTTP 401 {"cc":7,"error":"Invalid Authentication"}; the 2nd (after login) and 3rd returned 200. maximum_sessions/active_session are encoded: value & 0x7F, 255 = N/A [JS]. web time_out (1800 s) drives the UI idle-logout timer.
No certlogin field (X470 sent certlogin=0). Sent with X-CSRFTOKEN: "null" left over from the pre-login $.ajaxSetup. Response adds user_id, channel, passwordStatus vs X470.

Consolidated post-login call: IPMI Get Device ID fields (same as X470 /api/firmware-info) + user record + dashboard NTP/timezone + power-on-hours + audit count. GET with JSON Content-Type and a query string built by jQuery from {user_id, channel_id, user_name}.
B650 UI polls chassis-status (not /api/chassis) on a 5 s timer. Extra field power_cycle_interval (ms) is used by the Power Control page to time the post-cycle re-check (interval + 10 s) [JS].

Same order and sensor_number set as /api/sensors, but only {id,sensor_number,name} per entry, except sensors that are not in a normal state, which carry the full /api/sensors record (here FAN7_1, sensor_state 8 = Lower Non-Critical). The UI treats entries with owner_id as critical [JS].

cmd=1 returns only the audit record count [JS comment "audit count only"].
BMC self-description plus BMC NICs (usb0 host interface 169.254.0.17, eth0, eth1, bond0). All values are strings, "NA" for unknown. Second call returned Connection: close.
Powercontrol (power limit 500 W, HardPowerOff exception, consumption 0) and 15 voltage sensors with thresholds as strings ("NA" if unset); State "Absent" for PSU sensors.

Field renamed settable_readable_threshMask -> settable_flag; unset thresholds are the string "NA" (X470: 0.0); integral values serialise as JSON ints; unit "deg_c" (not degree sign). One active warning: FAN7_1 sensor_state 8 with accessible 0.
"Keep Share NIC Link Up" setting: vetobit 1 keeps the NC-SI shared-NIC PHY linked up across host resets. Write: PUT /api/asrr/setvetobit {"vetobit":0|1} [JS, not captured].

Selects which open-loop table the next getfanopenloopcontroltable returns (server-side cursor). table_numble 1..8 = customized table N; N|0x80 (129..136) = factory default table N [JS]. The page sends {"table_numble":1} unconditionally in afterRender, so merely opening the page issues this POST. Response body is "{ }".
24 (temperature degC, duty %) points of the table selected by the preceding setopenlooptablenumber. 255 = unused point. All 255 here = customized table 1 is empty.
Factory uid-0 shell account (sysadmin): enable_user_access 1 means the account is enabled.

User disabled bonding (bond_enable 1 -> 0). This restarts the BMC network stack; it is the last entry in the capture. bond_ifc is not returned by GET; the UI sends the <select> value (default first option "eth0").
Same pre-login 401 pattern as B650D4U (entry 11, 97 s before the 200 at entry 20). Body identical to the B650D4U capture.
3509 ms server wait (B650D4U: 360 ms; X470: 1491 ms).

15 user ids x 2 LAN channels (1, 8). New per-channel fields vs X470: channel, channel_type, userid, accessByChannel, privilegeByChannel, password_age, password_enddate; network_privilege renamed privilege; privilege_limit_serial dropped.
